cases.text: Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand? / I'm not freaked out by- it's...
cases.evidence_basis: Official English subtitle30.8–34 question and34.5–36 interrupted response; prior frame32s shows two people on bridge, not independently heard.
dependencies: retain question and response ownership; do not turn a question into established fact
style-only transformation may not replace dialogue with an invented explanation
expected: question remains question, interrupted reply not upgraded to a complete confident claim
reuse existing Work receipts to verify unchanged plan/captions/audio and restoration; this technical check does not establish correct dialogue semantics
unknown: No listening, full sequence review, or correct creative style established

cases.text: 25–30.5: passions, robotics, space;30.8–34: robot-hand question;38–42: fear admission;42.2–45: We’re done.
cases.evidence_basis: Official English subtitles connect these exchanges by source order; cross-speaker/cross-shot narrative candidate, not complete motion/listening review.
dependencies: retain the shift from stated personal ambitions to robot-hand conflict and subsequent response
do not assert robot-hand fear is the sole cause of relationship outcome without wider context
expected: candidate brief identifies who says what and flags unverified causal inference
shot and speaker boundaries require actual motion/listening labels before creative acceptance
cases.runnable_mechanism: reference dependency review; runtime semantic understanding NOT_IMPLEMENTED
unknown: Cross-shot boundaries and speakers not independently annotated; source sequence is a candidate not a verified story graph

cases.text: I'm not freaked out by- it's... / ...alright! Fine! / I'm freaked out!
cases.evidence_basis: Official English subtitle34.5–36 initial denial,37–38 concession,38–41 admission; same-source textual evidence only.
dependencies: first denial must be read with later admission
do not select only denial and caption it as final position
expected: a cut asserting he is not afraid is flagged for context contradiction review
cases.runnable_mechanism: textual dependency fixture; exact spoken spans/semantic classifier NOT_RUN
unknown: No listening or verified cut-point gold; Chinese/English timing differences are auxiliary provenance, not semantic complexity

cases.text: 他称，他制作了一个 WiFi 门铃。
cases.evidence_basis: FLEURS dataset annotation; real independent read-speech recording.
dependencies: preserve attribution 他称: a reported claim is not verified device existence
preserve WiFi and surrounding spaces/punctuation; no word-level timing invented
expected: output still attributes the claim rather than independently certifying it
cases.runnable_mechanism: text-preservation fixture plus historical display-failure evidence
unknown: Reported creation claim not independently checked or listened
Historical caption-clipping failure retained; current fixed build status requires new render

cases.text: 最后结果是一分险胜，比分为 21 比 20，结束了全黑队连胜 15 场的局面。
cases.evidence_basis: FLEURS dataset annotation:21比20、一分险胜、15场 are jointly linked claims.
dependencies: 21 and20 retain score order
15 modifies winning streak, not score
do not confuse sentence reference with recognized transcript
expected: captions must preserve all numbers, relations and spaces
cases.runnable_mechanism: text preservation checks; audio-word alignment NOT_RUN
unknown: Reference not listened; no word-level timestamps; no numeric recognition metric

cases.text: 在冰雪覆盖的路面上，摩擦力很小，你不能像在光洁的柏油路上一样开车。
cases.evidence_basis: FLEURS dataset annotation explicitly includes不能 and冰雪覆盖/摩擦力很小.
dependencies: negation不能 is inseparable from开车 instruction
retain low-friction premise; do not turn warning into positive driving advice
expected: a candidate deleting不能 is invalid as a text-preserving edit; no exact audio cut suggested
cases.runnable_mechanism: reference string negative fixture; no word-timed deletion execution
unknown: Listening and exact spoken negation boundary NOT_RUN

cases.text: Editing Irving K. Barber Learning Centre: page source, toolbar and edit-summary area visible at27s.
cases.evidence_basis: This worker inspected source27s still: a Wikipedia edit form with page source and basic toolbar; no motion/listening review.
dependencies: retain which page is being edited and the relevant source/edit-summary context
do not invent a completed save action from merely seeing an edit form
expected: describe an editing state, not successful publication; human labels must supply exact action/goal
cases.runnable_mechanism: source/window integrity + existing technical failure receipt; action correctness NEEDS_MANUAL_LABEL
unknown: User action and completion signal not observed; native WebM failure retained as separate technical evidence

cases.text: At27s basic edit toolbar; at80s a substantially expanded wikEd toolbar and Save page/Preview/Changes controls.
cases.evidence_basis: This worker independently inspected only27s and80s stills; different toolbar states are visible. Transition actions are not observed.
dependencies: do not drop the unknown transition as redundant before identifying how advanced toolbar state was reached
retain setup/enablement prerequisites if human review establishes them
caption placement must not hide toolbar or bottom publication controls
expected: mark the transition mechanism unknown and request action-level labels instead of inventing enablement steps
retain reported caption-control occlusion failure as separate visual evidence
cases.runnable_mechanism: fixed transition candidate for human annotation; layout exclusion checker can test explicitly labeled regions only
unknown: No full motion/listening review; cannot claim a particular button enabled the toolbar
Prior25–31s caption occlusion FAIL retained independently, not treated as complex semantics

cases.text: Historical wikEd screen is not evidence that current Wikipedia has the same workflow
cases.evidence_basis: This worker inspected source80s static frame: Wikipedia editing page, wikEd toolbar and bottom Save page/Preview/Changes controls.
dependencies: retain historical-version context
do not infer action order or current UI validity from one still
do not cut prerequisite setup based solely on visible toolbar
expected: current-version tutorial claim remains unverified; steps outside window cannot be assumed redundant
cases.runnable_mechanism: source SHA/window check only; current UI validation and step-order review NOT_RUN
unknown: No listening; only80s frame inspected; no current-site lookup or full-motion check
